column1: # comment: "Learning-slice alignments to schema.org's action vocabulary and PROV-O. The match is deliberately loose (skos:closeMatch, not equivalentClass): schema:LearnAction / schema:TeachAction model the ACT of gaining / imparting knowledge, whereas gmeow:LearningEvent is the cognitive-STATE-transition event that raises a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency or gmeow:SkillProficiency along the cognition / expertise spectrum \u2014 richer than a bare action, carrying trajectory (gmeow:fromLevel / gmeow:toLevel), variety (gmeow:learningType), and product (gmeow:produces). PROV-O is the activity / provenance face: a gmeow:LearningEvent is a prov:Activity that prov:generated a knowledge entity and whose acquired knowledge prov:wasDerivedFrom its gmeow:learnedFrom source. xAPI / the Experience API is the strongest external CONSUMER \u2014 learning records keyed by verbs such as <http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/experienced> and <http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/learned> \u2014 but it is a JSON Statement model with no stable OWL class IRIs for the event itself, so a gmeow:LearningEvent projects DOWN to an xAPI Statement at the projection layer (Actor=experiencer, Verb from gmeow:learningType, Object=gmeow:subjectTaught) and is referenced in prose rather than mapped as a TermEquivalence. The Dreyfus / knowledge-level value vocabularies have no stable external IRI counterpart and are intentionally left unmapped."

column6: A gmeow:LearningEvent is a prov:Activity that generates a knowledge entity; PROV models the activity / generation, gmeow adds the cognitive trajectory and the gufo occurrent / endurant split. Broad closeMatch.

schema:LearnAction is the act of gaining knowledge; gmeow:LearningEvent is the cognitive-state-transition occurrent that raises a knowledge / skill proficiency, carrying trajectory, variety, and product. closeMatch, not equivalentClass.

schema:TeachAction is the act of imparting knowledge; gmeow:Teaching is the reified gufo:Relator mediating one teacher, learners, and the subject taught — the endurant relation, not the act. closeMatch.

prov:wasDerivedFrom relates an entity to a source it was derived from; gmeow:learnedFrom relates the learning EVENT to the source the knowledge was acquired from (the provenance of acquired knowledge). closeMatch across the entity / event shift.

prov:generated relates an activity to an entity it produced; gmeow:produces relates a gmeow:LearningEvent to the enduring knowledge state (cognition / expertise proficiency, or a future gmeow:Concept) it settled. closeMatch.

schema:teaches links a learning resource / course to the competency it conveys; gmeow:subjectTaught links a gmeow:Teaching relator to its content. The gmeow domain is the reified relation, not the resource. closeMatch.
